insurer_name: IndusInd General Insurance Company Limited (formerly Reliance General Insurance)
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Personal Accident policy — pays a benefit on death, permanent total disablement, permanent partial disablement, or temporary total disablement caused by an accident. No medical waiting periods applicable.
copayment_trigger_notes: No co-payment applicable on benefit payouts

disease_wise_sub_limits.permanent_total_disablement: 100% of Capital Sum Insured (loss of two limbs, two eyes or one limb + one eye)
disease_wise_sub_limits.temporary_total_disablement: 1% of Capital Sum Insured per week, max Rs. 5,000/week across all PA policies

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Carriage of dead body — 2% of Capital Sum Insured or Rs. specified amount for transportation of insured's body to place of residence following an accident outside the place of residence

permanent_exclusions: intentional self-injury, suicide or attempted suicide
intoxication by alcohol, drugs or narcotics
breach of law with criminal intent
childbirth, pregnancy or related medical complications (PA scope)
notable_exclusions_summary: Pure personal-accident benefit policy — pays on accidental death, permanent disablement, and weekly compensation for temporary disablement. Add-on covers (carriage of dead body, education grant for dependent children) included. No medical-illness cover.
claim_process_summary: Notify insurer of accident; submit medical reports, FIR (where applicable), death certificate and claim form. Benefit paid as lump sum or weekly per cover.
available_riders: Education Grant for dependent children (on death/PTD of insured)
